title: 2024年全国教育事业发展统计公报
publisher: Ministry of Education of the PRC
caveats: Aggregate education totals; not discipline-specific.
notes: National baseline for school counts, higher-education gross enrollment, and macro supply trend checks.

title: 高等教育学生数
publisher: Ministry of Education of the PRC
caveats: National total only; no field-of-study split.
notes: Useful for total postgraduate, bachelor, and vocational stock/flow baselines before allocating by province and discipline.

title: 高等学校（机构）研究生数
publisher: Ministry of Education of the PRC
caveats: Province-level, but still not major-specific.
notes: Best official province-level source for postgraduate graduates, entrants, and enrolment in the annual MOE release.

title: 高等教育普通本科学生数
publisher: Ministry of Education of the PRC
caveats: Province-level only; not by discipline.
notes: Useful for province weighting of undergraduate talent pools that may feed tooling-relevant majors such as materials, chemistry, optics, instrumentation, and mechanical engineering.

title: 教育部关于公布2024年度普通高等学校本科专业备案和审批结果及《普通高等学校本科专业目录（2025年）》的通知
publisher: Ministry of Education of the PRC
caveats: Catalog and filing results; not enrollment counts.
notes: Authoritative map of officially recognized undergraduate majors and newly added programs; useful for tracking tooling-adjacent major expansion.

title: 研究生教育学科专业目录（2022年）发布，自2023年起实施
publisher: Ministry of Education of the PRC
caveats: Catalog, not graduate counts.
notes: Authoritative graduate-discipline taxonomy; important for normalizing optics, instrumentation, materials, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, and IC-related graduate programs.

title: 中国统计年鉴
publisher: National Bureau of Statistics of China
caveats: Landing page rather than a direct education chapter; navigation can change.
notes: Useful as a stable macro cross-check alongside MOE tables, especially for long-run national higher-education trend series.

title: 上海市经济信息化委等关于印发《上海市重点领域（产业类）紧缺人才开发目录》的通知
publisher: Shanghai Municipal Commission of Economy and Informatization and partner agencies
caveats: Older than other shortage sources; attachment-based.
notes: Good benchmark source for Shanghai shortage categories and skill framing in strategic industries; useful historically for the IC/tooling ecosystem in the Yangtze River Delta.

title: 深圳市人力资源和社会保障局关于印发《深圳市半导体与集成电路产业高端紧缺岗位清单（试行）》《深圳市生物医药产业高端紧缺岗位清单（试行）》的通知
publisher: Shenzhen Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau
caveats: Focused on Shenzhen and high-end roles; attachment contains the detail.
notes: One of the most directly reusable official role-level demand sources for semiconductor and integrated-circuit talent in South China.

title: 宝安构建重点产业“急需紧缺人才蓄水池”
caveats: Announcement page summarizes the directory rather than reproducing all rows.
notes: Valuable for role, salary, and tightness scoring in a district with meaningful semiconductor and manufacturing activity; especially useful for market-facing demand signals.

title: 天津市高层次和急需紧缺人才开发目录
publisher: Tianjin Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau
caveats: Covers 12 industry chains, not only semiconductors.
notes: Strong official source because it explicitly includes the integrated-circuit chain and attaches the full directory.

title: 关于公布《成渝地区双城经济圈急需紧缺人才目录（2023年）》的通告
publisher: Sichuan Provincial Department of Human Resources and Social Security and Chongqing Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau
caveats: Multi-industry regional document; semiconductor roles must be filtered from broader clusters.
notes: Useful for West China demand mapping, especially where equipment, electronics, and advanced manufacturing talent markets overlap.

title: 精密仪器系概况
caveats: Department overview, not graduate output data.
notes: High-value source for lithography-sidebar and metrology talent mapping because it documents instruments, optics, testing platforms, and training depth.

title: 光电科学与工程学院
caveats: Static school profile; no enrollment figures on the page.
notes: Important for optics, optical instrumentation, sensing, and imaging pipelines relevant to lithography and inspection.

title: 学院简介
caveats: School profile; no annual counts.
notes: Useful for metrology and ultra-precision instrumentation talent, with explicit emphasis on precision instruments and measurement.

title: 学院简介
caveats: Broad chemical-engineering profile rather than semiconductor-specific.
notes: Good proxy for etch, clean, strip, wet-process, and materials-facing talent supply via chemical engineering and fine chemicals strengths.

title: 学院简介
caveats: Institutional self-description.
notes: High-value source for integrated-circuit process, CAD, and micro/nano-electronics training that can feed equipment and process-engineering roles.

title: 精密仪器与光电子工程学院
caveats: School profile, not yearly throughput.
notes: Strong source for precision testing, micro/nano manufacturing, sensing, and optical engineering talent relevant to metrology and inspection.

title: 半导体装备
caveats: Corporate self-description; no disclosed workforce-by-function.
notes: Very reusable for tool-category mapping because it explicitly lists etch, PVD, CVD, WET, furnace, implant, RTP, and epi products plus manufacturing bases.

title: Advanced Micro-Fabrication Equipment Inc. China
caveats: Corporate source; English site emphasizes product families more than personnel data.
notes: Core source for etch and deposition product-line mapping and for the lithography-constraint side note that China is stronger in etch/deposition than lithography.

title: 拓荆科技股份有限公司
caveats: Corporate source; no province-by-province talent detail.
notes: Very useful for deposition category coverage because it lists PECVD, ALD, SACVD, HDPCVD, Flowable CVD, hybrid bonding, and related metrology.

title: 盛美半导体设备（上海）股份有限公司
caveats: Corporate source; some claims are marketing-oriented.
notes: High-value clean-tool source with wet cleaning, electroplating, furnace, track, and PECVD coverage; especially useful for clean/strip and adjacent front-end tools.

title: 北京电子量检测装备有限责任公司
publisher: Beijing Electronics Inspection and Metrology Equipment
caveats: Corporate source; product breadth may exceed front-end semiconductor tooling.
notes: Useful metrology/inspection anchor source because it explicitly covers pattern defect inspection, micro/nano morphology metrology, and mask/inspection-adjacent capabilities.

title: 上海微电子装备(集团)股份有限公司
caveats: Homepage is broad; detailed product pages may need separate scraping later.
notes: Essential lithography-sidebar source for mapping China’s main domestic lithography champion and its IC, packaging, display, MEMS, LED, and power-device application footprint.

title: Oriental Chip Port of Lingang Special Area
publisher: Shanghai Municipal Commission of Economy and Informatization
caveats: English-language summary page rather than a full tenant list.
notes: Excellent park-level source because it explicitly highlights distinctive processes, key equipment, basic materials, and packaging/testing in Lingang.

title: 北京亦庄创新发布第626次网络发布
caveats: Cluster release rather than a structured directory.
notes: Very useful for cluster geography because it explicitly says Beijing E-Town has design, manufacturing, packaging, equipment, parts, and materials in one IC chain.

title: 《苏州工业园区全面推进集成电路产业创新集群发展行动计划（2022-2025）》
caveats: Policy/action-plan source rather than a tenant directory.
notes: Strong for cluster observation design because it explicitly names key equipment directions such as lithography, epitaxy, and test, and gives talent and firm targets.

title: 厦门海沧集成电路产业园
caveats: Park profile; counts are cluster-level and may change over time.
notes: Useful South China park source with named functional zones and resident manufacturing projects; good for geographic demand mapping and partner-ecosystem screening.

title: 资助项目查询
publisher: National Natural Science Foundation of China
caveats: Project query is not tooling-specific; results need keyword design and discipline filters.
notes: Best official grant proxy for tracking institutions and topics in plasma, deposition, optics, instrumentation, process chemistry, and related fields.

title: 国家知识产权局专利检索及分析系统介绍
source_type: official patent search and analysis system
caveats: Requires careful query design; patent counts can overstate practical capability.
notes: Best official patent proxy for company, inventor, region, and topic trends in etch, clean, deposition, metrology, optics, and semiconductor equipment subsystems.

title: 万方数据知识服务平台
caveats: Commercial platform; access may depend on institutional subscription.
notes: Strong literature proxy for Chinese-language papers, theses, standards-adjacent content, and institutional publication clustering.

title: 国家科技报告服务系统
publisher: National Science and Technology Report Service System
caveats: Coverage depends on deposited reports; some full text requires authenticated access.
notes: Useful for state-funded project reports and technical-report searches that can surface applied tooling and process-development work beyond journal articles.

title: 中国科学院文献情报中心
publisher: National Science Library, Chinese Academy of Sciences
caveats: Homepage links to CSCD rather than giving a direct dataset description on the same page.
notes: Useful citation-index proxy for high-quality Chinese scientific output and institutional influence in engineering, optics, materials, and instrumentation.

title: China’s Progress in Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment
publisher: Center for Security and Emerging Technology
caveats: Analytical framing piece, not a primary Chinese observation source.
notes: High-value framing report on China’s strengths and weaknesses in SME, especially the gap between etch/deposition progress and lithography/metrology constraints.

title: Inside Beijing’s Chipmaking Offensive
publisher: Center for Security and Emerging Technology
caveats: Article-level framing built on CSET ETO rather than a raw Chinese dataset.
notes: Useful current framing for which Chinese tool segments are gaining share, with especially relevant discussion of dry etch, clean, deposition, CMP, and lithography constraints.

title: America Faces Significant Shortage of Tech Workers in Semiconductor Industry and Throughout U.S. Economy
caveats: U.S.-focused and not China-specific.
notes: Useful comparative framing for how semiconductor workforce shortages are measured and communicated, and for benchmarking demand-side logic.

title: 2026 Global Semiconductor Industry Outlook
caveats: Global outlook; not China-tooling specific.
notes: Useful for macro framing on capex, AI-driven equipment demand, packaging, memory, infrastructure, and talent availability as strategic constraints.

title: Filling the talent gap in semiconductors
caveats: Global and modeled rather than built from Chinese public administrative data.
notes: Useful comparative framing for engineer and technician bottlenecks, talent clusters, and how equipment makers are affected by the same labor constraints as fabs.

title: ACM Research Shanghai 2025 annual report
caveats: Listed-company disclosure; role categories are aggregated and not segment-specific.
notes: Clean/strip product and service-heavy workforce evidence.

title: AMEC 2025 annual report
caveats: Listed-company disclosure; product and workforce data are aggregated.
notes: Etch product maturity and R&D composition.

title: NAURA 2025 annual report
caveats: Listed-company disclosure; role labels are aggregated and not directly comparable to job postings.
notes: Scale, R&D intensity, and customer-service expansion.

title: Piotech 2025 financing report
caveats: Corporate financing disclosure; product and demand framing may be promotional.
notes: Deposition demand mechanics and product families.

title: Jingce 2025 annual report summary
caveats: Annual report summary; use full filing before making strong product or workforce claims.
notes: Metrology and inspection product taxonomy.
